storyline_causality_quote: Concerns about US-Iran attacks, the sea blockade, and tanker safety continued on July 14, so the flashy 20% plan left the stage, but the chart only pulled back briefly before recovering: the policy turn and the oil chart’s “not over yet” movement happened on the same day.
entertainment_quote: The change was sudden. But to read the oil move, the dates must be kept separate.
comprehension_quote: The next day, Trump said the 20% plan would be replaced by trade and investment projects between Gulf states and the US.
thinness_quote: On July 13, Brent rose about 10% and settled at about $83 a barrel.
